_comment: Release data read by the build scripts (build_universal.ps1, build_variants.ps1, pack_universal.ps1, build/release.ps1) and by the macOS and Linux workflows. Update bench at every change of the search tree; bench_possolver is the analysis-mode bench of a -PosSolver build (null = unknown, give it on the command line). The network is the file the engine loads by default (CN_DEFAULT_NET_FILE); on Windows the scripts also copy it under the name triumv.rc embeds.
